ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: "SURVEY OF COLLABORATIVE PIANO SKILLS.” Survey of beginning to advanced concepts of collaborative piano playing. Introduction to career opportunities in collaborative piano related fields. Topics and genres covered include both instrumental and vocal repertoire: instrumental sonatas and concertos, art song, opera, music theater; 21st century music, popular music, early music/continuo; jazz, vocal coaching. Different approaches to wind, string, brass, vocal, opera, orchestra, choral repertoire and rehearsals will be discussed. Prerequisite: Admission in music as a piano, organ, harpsichord, accompanying, jazz or conducting major; or enrollment in MUS 164, 174, or 431 equivalent; or consent of instructor.
